name: Ahrefs
one_liner: Ahrefs offers a REST API for marketing and SEO data, accessed via API keys or OAuth2, with an official MCP server for AI assistants.
auth_notes: API key passed in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.
access_notes: API access requires a Lite or higher subscription plan.

gate.process: Generate an API key in your Ahrefs account settings.

evidence.snippet: Using API v3 from any of the above methods is possible for Lite and higher subscription plans, and consume from the same API & Integrations limit.
Ahrefs now has an official MCP server that connects directly to Claude and ChatGPT.

notes: The API uses a unit-based billing model; each request consumes units based on rows and fields returned.
